registration.method: 生活一区核实DOCX实建图S=54477.7平方米，与2025控规A-56面积54478平方米及建二路/南湾路、地块形状交叉对应，属于有依据的对应推断。实建小图不够清晰，轮廓与退台主要描绘image1报建屋顶图，照片参考水平阳台带。按实建地块面积校准图上红线近似比例，北向约45度；层数简化、层高估算，全园仍为地块级定位，不是实建测绘模型。

limitations: A-56 correspondence is inferred from area and surrounding roads. Planning roof diagram supplies approximate silhouettes; floor heights are estimated. Building dimensions are estimates; this is not a planning-compliance review. Scale comes from the approximate planning redline area matched to the actual survey parcel area; global CRS is not registered.
